inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted-average 1,388,474,000 shares from the H1 FY2026 interim diluted-EPS note (basic 1,387,188,000 + options); FY2025 AR diluted 1,385,863,000. Held FLAT: the June-2025 option grant is charged through the SBC line, and buybacks (HK$6.8m FY2025) roughly offset deferred-share issuance.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim: unsecured bank borrowings HK$13,175.973m (1,369.760 non-current + 11,806.213 current) less cash and bank balances HK$4,260.026m. This is the company's own net-debt definition (net debt/total assets 0.18). Lease liabilities (HK$419.6m) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Bank-acceptance-bill 'secured obligations' (HK$3,808.0m) and the pledged deposits backing them (HK$3,828.3m) are carried as a matched pair in equity_bridge rather than in net debt. SEASONALITY: H1 net debt is always the year's high (FY2025 year-end 3,885; H1 FY2025 5,709; H1 FY2026 8,916 after a HK$5.1bn inventory build for AI-server orders). Using the H1 figure as the anchor is the rule (latest filing) and is conservative: roughly half a year of the FY2026 working-capital charge in the projection (~HK$0.7bn, ~HK$0.5/share) is already inside this net-debt figure.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR note 15: 29.4m share options granted 23 Jun 2025, total grant-date fair value HK$37.3m vesting against FY2025-27 growth hurdles (~HK$12m/yr, ~0.01% of revenue); no separate share-based-payment expense line in note 24 or the note-30 cash-flow reconciliation. Treated as an SBC-zero market; forward sbc_pct_path kept explicit at 0% (SBC-zero market rule): the ~HK$12m/yr is 0.01% of revenue, below the build's resolution, and a non-zero token would make the house/street band degenerate.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing: repurchase of shares/treasury/deferred shares net HK$6.8m (FY2024 11.3m, FY2023 56.3m). Token repurchaser; the flat count is funded.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z (HKEX regular close, Friday; valuation written Saturday 2026-10-11)
inputs.wacc_rationale: HKD flows discounted at an HKD-built rate (HKD is USD-pegged, so the risk-free anchor is the HK 10-year ~3.6-4.0%). Cost of equity ~10.5-11%: rf 3.8% + beta ~1.15 x ERP 6% incl. China/SEA country premium. After-tax cost of debt ~3.7% (floating HK$13.2bn bank lines at ~4.5%, 17% tax). Market-value weights ~60/40 on gross debt give ~7.8%; the house uses 9.0% because much of the bank debt is seasonal working-capital funding that a buyer would not treat as permanent capital, and because a thin-margin (4.5% GM, ~2% EBITDA) distributor's FCF is more volatile than its revenue. Risk is charged ONCE: no per-scenario WACC differences, cyclicality and export-control risk live in the bear flows and in the 25% bear weight.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Full cash lease payment (FY2025: capital element HK$193.472m + interest on lease liabilities HK$14.611m = HK$208.1m, 0.21% of revenue) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (HK$419.6m at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; da_pct is owned D&A only (FY2025 PPE depreciation 126.855 incl. ~69 ROU, amortisation 3.701 -> ex-ROU ~61.5m = 0.063% of revenue), so the lease is not charged twice through ROU depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: non-controlling interests (VSTECS Berhad minorities etc.) took HK$82.0m of FY2025 profit (1,435.5 total less 1,353.5 attributable, 5.7% of post-tax profit, ~4.8% of PBT). This leakage is folded into cash_tax_rate_path (cash tax ~17.4% of PBT [HK$297.8m paid / HK$1,713.6m PBT] + ~4.8% NCI = 22% combined). NCI book value (HK$308.3m at 30 Jun 2026) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge.
inputs.ebitda_basis: Segment results (operating profit before finance costs, fair-value gains on financial assets and share of associates) + D&A. FY2025: 1,889.1 + 130.6 = HK$2,019.7m = 2.07% of revenue; FY2024: 1,704.0 + 121.1 = 2.05%; H1 FY2026: 1,229.8 + ~65 = ~2.46% of HK$52,610m (the AI/memory upcycle). Fair-value gains (HK$97.2m FY2025) and share of associates' profits (HK$95.2m) are stripped from the flows and their source assets added to the bridge (matching-asset rule). FY0 calibration: EBITDA 2,020 - lease 208 - owned D&A 61.5 = EBIT 1,750; x (1-22%) = NOPAT 1,365 vs attributable NI 1,353.5 (which includes +97 FV, +95 associates, -368 interest, -82 NCI) -- ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.working_capital_note: Distributor: receivables + inventory > payables, so growth CONSUMES cash. Net working capital (trade receivables + inventories - trade payables - contract liabilities) was HK$11.4bn = 11.7% of revenue at FY2025 and 13.0% at FY2024. Long-run check FY2018-25: cumulative OCF HK$8.1bn vs cumulative NI 8.1bn + interest paid (financing) 2.2bn + D&A ~0.9bn = 11.4bn pre-WC, so WC absorbed ~3.4bn on HK$35.1bn of revenue growth = 9.6%. wc_capture_pct is therefore NEGATIVE: -10 base, -8 bull (better vendor terms / payables stretch as in FY2025), -12 bear.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon (margins still normalising from the FY2026 AI/memory upcycle and the bear case carries a mid-horizon downcycle). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' with owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied: (a) HKD flows / HKD quote / HKD WACC; (b) lease treatment B; (c) NCI via leakage; (d) matching-asset rule for associates and FVPL investments; (e) SBC-zero market, sbc row kept visible at 0.01%; (f) risk charged once. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 1,913.9 (OCF 1,954.6 - capex 40.7) - lease principal 193.5 = HK$1,720.4m; SBC ~0, interest income (HK$32.5m) NOT stripped because the company is a net debtor. Note reported OCF is BEFORE interest paid (HK$368.0m sits in financing) -- irrelevant to the unlevered build, which deducts net debt instead. Terminal cap 12x FCF (cyclical, thin-margin distributor; method file says 12-15x for cyclicals). No numeric company guidance exists (FY2025 chairman's letter and H1 FY2026 'Prospects' are qualitative); FY2026 year-1 growth is judged from H1 FY2026 actuals (+15.6% revenue, +50% attributable profit, GM 5.0% vs 4.8%) and the H2/H1 seasonal ratio (1.145 in FY2025), which implies ~HK$112.8bn / +15.6% for the full year; CITIC (Oct-2025) FY2026E HK$116.5bn is the street high. The H1 FY2026 working-capital build (OCF -HK$4,790m, inventories +HK$5.1bn) is inside the net-debt anchor; the DCF does not treat it as a run-rate.
inputs.dividend_note: FY2025 final dividend HK$600m proposed (vs HK$369m FY2024), still payable at 30 June 2026 (HK$597.2m) and paid in July; deducted in equity_bridge because the current price is ex that dividend.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (8.2%) cross-checked against revenue_3yr_cagr (8.1%); applied as a front-loaded path (FY2026 upcycle) decelerating to 3% by year 9
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 8.2% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 5.3% (55% relative divergence): FY2020 was a cyclical EPS high (HK$0.75) and FY2022 a trough (HK$0.58), so EPS CAGRs are endpoint-sensitive (3yr EPS CAGR is 18.9% off the FY2022 trough). Equity CAGR is the steadier series and is used.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - lease principal (IFRS 16 from FY2019); SBC ~0; interest income not stripped (net debtor). The series is working-capital driven and swings between -HK$0.9bn and +HK$2.5bn, so FCF CAGRs are not meaningful (3yr undefined off the FY2022 HK$-88m base; 5yr -7.0% off the FY2020 inventory-release peak). Over FY2018-25 cumulative owner FCF (HK$6.8bn) ran at ~85% of cumulative attributable NI (HK$8.1bn), which is the conversion the component build reproduces at terminal.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +14%: H1 +15.6% actual, H2 FY2025 comp is tougher (+6.3%), seasonal run-rate implies ~+15.6%; base shades below. FY2027 +9% as the AI/memory upcycle matures, then decelerating from the 8% historical equity/revenue CAGR to 3% HKD nominal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA (pre-lease) 2.07%, FY2024 2.05%, H1 FY2026 ~2.46%. Base takes 2.35% for FY2026 (H2 seasonally lower than H1's 2.46%) and fades to 2.25% -- a 20bp structural gain over FY2024-25 from enterprise/cloud/AI mix, not the full upcycle margin.
base.tax_rationale: 17.4% cash tax (FY2025 paid/PBT; HK 16.5%, PRC 25%, SEA 17-25%, 5% PRC dividend WHT) + ~4.8% NCI leakage of PBT = 22%, flat.

bull.rationale: FY2026 +18% (CITIC's HK$116.5bn), the SEA AI data-centre build-out plus China domestic-compute substitution sustain double-digit growth through FY2028; mix shift lifts EBITDA to 2.6% (H1 FY2026 run-rate held, plus cloud/AI services); vendor terms let WC intensity fall to 8% of incremental revenue.

bear.rationale: H2 FY2026 slows sharply (full year +9%), then a FY2027-28 downcycle: memory/component prices reverse, an export-control or transshipment-compliance shock cuts NVIDIA-related SEA volumes, and China enterprise/government IT spend stalls. EBITDA falls back below the FY2024 level (1.85% trough, 2.0% recovery -- FY2022's trough was 1.7% OpM on 4.4% GM); receivable provisions (already rising in H1 FY2026) and inventory keep WC intensity at 12%.

scenario_narratives.base: VSTECS compounds as the region's largest independent ICT distributor through the current AI computing-power cycle without keeping all of the cycle's margin. FY2026 revenue grows ~14% (H1 +15.6%) and the pre-lease EBITDA margin settles at 2.25-2.35% -- 20-30bp above FY2024-25 as enterprise systems, cloud (+29%) and AI infrastructure gain share of mix, but below the H1 FY2026 2.46% peak. Growth decelerates to 3% HKD nominal by FY2034. Working capital stays the business's defining constraint: every HK$100 of incremental revenue ties up HK$10, so owner FCF runs at ~80% of NOPAT at terminal and the H1 FY2026 HK$8.9bn net-debt position (after the AI-server inventory build) is carried as the anchor. Value is capped at 12x terminal FCF: a thin-margin distributor does not earn a compounder's multiple.
scenario_narratives.bull: The dual 'domestic innovation + overseas expansion' strategy delivers: China's domestic-chip substitution (Huawei Ascend, Hygon) and the Southeast Asian hyperscaler/sovereign AI data-centre build-out (NVIDIA regional partner, Starlink, cloud at +30-120%) keep revenue growth in double digits through FY2028 (FY2026 +18%, in line with CITIC's HK$116.5bn). Mix shift and operating leverage hold the EBITDA margin at the H1 FY2026 run-rate and lift it to 2.6%; vendor-financed payables keep incremental WC at 8%. The stock's re-rating (ATH HK$12.22, Aug-2025) resumes as FY2026 attributable profit approaches HK$1.9bn.
scenario_narratives.bear: The AI order cycle proves to be a stocking cycle. H2 FY2026 slows, then FY2027-28 see a component-price reversal and a US export-control / Southeast-Asia transshipment-compliance shock that cuts the NVIDIA-related business while China enterprise and government IT budgets stall; revenue falls 3% in FY2028 and the pre-lease EBITDA margin drops to 1.85%, below the FY2024 level. The HK$13.2bn of floating-rate bank debt built up to fund the H1 FY2026 inventory/receivable position is refinanced at higher spreads, receivable provisions rise further, and WC intensity sits at 12%. Growth recovers only to 2.5-3%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default 15/50/35 moved to 25/50/25. Bear up to 25% because (i) borrowings rose from HK$8.8bn to HK$13.2bn in six months with H1 FY2026 OCF of -HK$4.8bn, so a cycle turn now meets a stretched balance sheet; (ii) the export-control / transshipment tail risk is a single-regulator dependency for the fastest-growing (SEA AI) line; (iii) the FY2025-H1 FY2026 margins are cyclical highs. Bull down to 25% because the bull case needs several independent things to hold at once -- continued AI capex, a sustained memory/component price tailwind, margin retention in a thin-margin industry, and better working-capital terms.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A high-volume, 4.5%-gross-margin ICT distributor is valued on the cash it can distribute after funding the working capital its growth requires, not on reported profit. The build strips non-operating income (associates, fair-value gains) and adds those assets back in the bridge, charges leases as an operating cost, folds minority leakage into the tax line, deducts the latest (seasonally high) net debt and the dividend already declared, and caps the terminal value at 12x FCF. The FY2026 AI/memory upcycle is given partial credit in the margin path, not full credit in perpetuity.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital intensity: a 2pp change in wc_capture_pct (e.g. -8 vs -12) moves terminal FCF conversion by ~10% and is the largest single driver after the margin

Net-debt anchor seasonality: the 30 June 2026 net debt (HK$8.9bn) is ~HK$5bn above the December 2025 figure because of an AI-server inventory build; if year-end FY2026 net debt reverts toward HK$4-5bn the equity value rises ~HK$3/share mechanically
Margin durability: the pre-lease EBITDA margin has ranged 1.7-2.5%; the base path at 2.25% assumes the mix gain persists but the H1 FY2026 peak does not
US export controls / Southeast-Asia transshipment scrutiny on NVIDIA-related distribution; Huawei and other vendor-authorisation concentration
Floating-rate HK$13.2bn bank debt: +100bp costs ~HK$130m/yr pre-tax, ~7% of FY2025 PBT
Level-3 unlisted investments (HK$629m, 50% haircut taken) and receivable provisions (HK$147m in H1 FY2026, rising)
